method: Paper only. Each model sees the same Hyperliquid data every 15 minutes and must answer LONG or SHORT (no standing aside) with its confidence and one invalidation level. A call stays open while the direction is unchanged; it closes on a flip, when a 1-minute bar reaches its profit target (a win), or when one touches its invalidation level (a loss; if one bar touches both, the loss is booked). Result at leverage L: a move of 1/L against the position at any time is a total loss of that position; otherwise L times the price change. Fees, funding and slippage are not modelled.
